name: @dsh-user/workspace-files
description: Web sidebar workspace file tree + drag-to-reference plugin (pure plugin, no product-source changes). Host half serves per-workspace directory listings over a same-origin HTTP route; browser half renders a drawer with per-workspace file tree / conversations and drops '@relative' references into the composer.

scripts.selfcheck: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && echo host+client ok
